profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: If the sky is always dark, then survive in the dark; if making noise is dangerous, then remain silent; if you feel unable to shine, then crouch in the corner. But don't defend the darkness when you are used to it; don't be proud of your own complacency; don't ridicule those who are braver and more passionate than yourself. We can be humble as dust, but not twisted like maggots.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design, development and test of main product; ERP software O-Negocios management system.
- Implementation of interfaces to consume data from customer’s application based on different 
   technologies combination; Visual FoxPro, Ruby, C# .NET, Java, PHP and data sources like Sql Server, 
   PostgreSql, MySql. 
- Programming of class libraries for Invoicing Electronic application using REST API standards and 
  web services.
- IT consulting services for companies in the commercial and manufacturing sector.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · Software ERP · C# · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · Desarrollo de base de datos · PostgreSQL · Ciencias de la computación · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · HTML · Java · Microsoft SQL Server · Programación orientada a objetos (POO)

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Implementation of Electronic Invoicing interface to connect with API Rest services with the computer system ERP – software of the company.
- Responsible for the design and modeling the databases for sales systems, warehouses, Purchasing Logistics, Production Control, Accounting, custom accounts receivable modules of ERP software.
- Responsible for coding and maintenance of programs, control source code with Git, and elaboration of all class libraries with the business core of the company.
- Pilot project for the migration of the sales module transferring the database to a provider in the cloud to be consumed with app development with android and Kotlin.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · Software ERP · C# · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Diseño de software · Transferencia de Estado Representacional (REST) · Ciencias de la computación · Diseño de bases de datos · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

company.name: Ingenieria y Desarrollo del Caucho S.A.C.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Development and maintenance of interface to export /import data to synchronize the information of Electronic Books with (EXACTUS) accounting and (FICS) sales systems both development in an ecosystem with SQL Server database with VB.net and the CARGO transportation in-House software development with JAVA and PostgreSQL database.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · Bases de datos · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · PostgreSQL · Desarrollo de software · Ciencias de la computación · SQL · HTML · Java · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Sofware development
positions.description: Responsible for the development and maintenance of sales systems, warehouses, Purchasing Logistics, Accounting, Cash and Banks, Accounts Receivable ERP - O-Negocios.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · Software ERP · Escritorio remoto de Windows · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Windows Server · Ciencias de la computación · Diseño de bases de datos · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for the development of sales, warehouses, Logistics, Production Control, accounting, 
  custom accounts receivable systems all integrated with an ERP software based on client server 
  application developed in Visual Foxpro with Sql Server.
- Responsible for the maintenance of programs, control source code, and derived applications, under 
  a strict confidentiality contract with the company.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
- Head of the Data Interfaces Project between the old systems on Novell Network - DOS and the 
  systems on Client / Server Platform on Windows NT.
- Recognition by the Systems Headquarters for analysis capacity, during the development of the data 
  interfaces project
- Design and programming of the Commercial system.
- Product Development: Garment consumption by quotation to customers and production orders.
- Integration between SQL Server 7.0 database and MS Excel 97 and 2000 spreadsheet.
- Development of DLLs Libraries on Windows NT Platform, Sql Server 7.0 and Visual Foxpro 6.0.
- Implementation of Active OCXs controls with Visual Basic 6.0.
- Development of Intranet messaging utility for remote control and auditing of PCs via TCP / IP 
   Protocol; designed for critical notifications, more versatile than Windows Winpopup and faster than 
  email notification.
- Training of the personnel of the Systems Development area in the use of new tools and Visual 
   Foxpro 6.0 Framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · data analisis · Extraer, transformar y cargar (ETL) · Sistemas operativos · Ingeniería de requisitos · Ciencias de la computación · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Systems Consultant
positions.description:
- Software development and implementation of integrated systems of Accounting, Cash and Banks, 
   Sales, Accounts Receivable and Warehouse.
- Design and implementation of the Windows NT network

positions.title: Information System Manager
positions.description:
- Administration and development of the systems area at the San Isidro headquarters and the Cañete 
   Plant.
- Design, development and implementation of Warehouse and Inventory systems, Production 
  Control, Purchasing Logistics, Cash Flow, Accounting, Payroll and Personnel Checking Account.
- Novell 3.12 network migration to Windows NT 4.0., Including software and hardware upgrades.
   Budget of around US $ 50,000, executed during 1998 and the first semester of 1999.
-  Preparation and execution of the correction plan and preparation of the systems for the arrival of 
   the year 2000. Prerequisite for obtaining a loan of approximately US $ 3,000,000 to be granted by 
   the World Bank.
-  In charge of hardware maintenance at the San Isidro headquarters and the Cañete Plant, both for 
   workstations and servers.
-  Evaluation of the staff members of the work team.
- Creation of the framework platform with which the company's systems, libraries and templates were 
   developed using Visual Foxpro and Sql Server.
- Start of the design and development of the Warehouse and Inventory and Production Control 
   systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · Gestión de proyectos · Ingeniería de requisitos · Desarrollo de base de datos · Diseño de bases de datos · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- In charge of the maintenance of the Warehouse, Sales, Accounting, Cash and Banks and Payroll 
   systems, among others, as part of the services provided to different clients such as: Vinsa, Mastercard, 
   Contix, TELE 2000, Celular 2000, SOC. Nacional de Industrias, Enafer (Empresa nacional de 
   Ferrocarriles del Perú), Editorial Navarrete, Polymagen, Ateco, Agraria el Escorial (Milkito), GME (Graña 
   y Montero Edificaciones).
-  Design and development of a clinical Laboratory Analysis system at the Stella Maris Clinic.
-  Training for personnel in the Development area, in the management and development of commercial 
    management systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Foxpro · Ingeniería de requisitos · Foxpro · Ciencias de la computación · Análisis de bases de datos · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)
